notes.subject: ⟨i stap we⟩ na i stap we
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i larim bikpela kwesten long wanpela tok tasol; ✍️ Hebrait ✍️ i onli ✍️ wanpela ✍️ taim ✍️.

notes.subject: Hena na Iva
notes.rationale: ✍️ Hebrait ✍️ i putum ✍️ Hena ✍️ na ✍️ Ivah ✋ olsem ✋ nem ✋ bilong ✋ ples ✋ o olsem ✋ ol ✋ king ✋ mo ✋ — KJV/JPS/BSB ✋ i ✋ skelim ✋ narawan.

notes.subject: long Hizkiyahu
notes.rationale: Tok bilong Sankerib i askim long man i rit — ol ✍️ god ✍️ bilong ✍️ ol ✍️ arapela ✍️ lain ✍️ i ✍️ no ✍️ save ✍️ pulap.

translation: King bilong Hamat i stap we, na king bilong Arpad i stap we, na king bilong taun Sefarvayim, Hena na Iva?
